findings.current: The chaos in Hubei Province will worsen, and further incidents will occur
findings.defect: The translation drops the consecutive or successive nature of the additional incidents expressed by 잇따른.
findings.rationale: The failure condition is not merely that more incidents occur; it specifies a succession of further incidents.
findings.replacement: The chaos in Hubei Province will worsen, and additional incidents will occur one after another

findings.current: It was unusual enough that he had never joined either the orthodox or unorthodox faction and had spent his entire life near Dongting Lake.
findings.defect: This weakens the explicit physical fact that the Dongting Fisherman never left the area around Dongting Lake.
findings.rationale: 벗어나지 않았다는 means he did not leave the vicinity, not merely that he spent his life there.
findings.replacement: It was unusual enough that he had never joined either the orthodox or unorthodox faction and had never left the area around Dongting Lake in his entire life.

findings.defect: The source addresses him with the honorific title 대협, but the assembled English omits it and lowers the register.
findings.rationale: The glossary establishes 대협 as “Great Hero” or “Sir,” and this occurrence is part of Taekyung’s deliberately respectful, comedic disclaimer.
findings.replacement: I respect Great Hero Seafaring King.

findings.current: Something dark and battered lay in his hand.
findings.defect: “Battered” adds a damage detail before the object is identified; the source only describes something darkish or dingy being held.
findings.rationale: 거무튀튀한 establishes a dark, dingy appearance, while the later explicit description of the weapon as broken should not be anticipated here.
findings.replacement: Something dark and dingy was in his hand.

summary: The chapter is largely faithful, but four minor source-fidelity defects remain involving a dropped sequence detail, a lost biographical fact, an omitted title, and an added physical detail.
